title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.08162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. translated_title: RouteAlign：将任务需求与模型画像对齐以实现大语言模型服务选择
translated_abstract: 大语言模型服务选择需要能够反映当前任务需求的性能证据。聚合分数掩盖了能力与难度上的差异，而语义上相似的示例可能涉及不同的技能组合。我们提出了RouteAlign，它利用任务需求来同时构建模型性能度量与服务选择的结构。任务需求描述了能力需求和难度，从而能够与相应的模型性能度量实现对齐。历史需求决定了结果如何贡献于全局画像与局部能力估计；新到来的需求则决定了这些度量如何为当前决策提供依据。一个共享的评分器整合了这些证据，而生成成本偏好则控制在符合条件的服务中进行选择。在多样化任务和异构大语言模型服务上的评估表明，RouteAlign扩展了经验性的质量-成本权衡边界。
tldr: RouteAlign通过将任务需求（能力需求与难度）与模型性能画像对齐，并利用共享评分器和生成成本偏好进行选择，从而在异构大语言模型服务中实现更精准的服务选择。
en_tdlr: RouteAlign aligns task requirements (capability demand and difficulty) with model performance profiles to enable more accurate LLM service selection across diverse tasks and heterogeneous services.
